text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose...! I won't!!
Especially not to you...!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—...*chuckle*
Do pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
What I'm looking at... is far beyond that!
HAAAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh!
Aaaaarrrrggghhh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That magnificent feat was accomplished with such effortless grace, and yet with overwhelming power.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Gentildonna!
Gentildonnaa--!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The fourth in history!
A new Triple Tiara umamusume is born!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooohh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...First stage cleared.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sharp, commanding voice cut through
the commotion of the venue—
and in an instant, total silence fell.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Once again, allow me to introduce myself.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My name is Gentildonna.
I have just been crowned with the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: However, this is only the beginning. Everyone, please be sure not to miss a single moment.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
With this power I showed you today...
I shall claim everything.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... You are all truly fortunate,
to have been born in an era graced by none other than myself.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
...!
So that's... Gentildonna...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
"—So gorgeous, so strong...
She's just so cool...!!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, uuuuugh...!
...Aah... Aaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...This... wasn't supposed to—
It's w-wrong...! But...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I will stand at the pinnacle...
Because I... I am—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We welcome the Triple Tiara Umamusume
with all the applause we can muster.
She has truly proven her strength.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"That is one...
accomplished."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
And? What are
your thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
They will offer the highest praise
to the lady who wears the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna strikes a dignified pose for me.
Watching her, naturally...
choice_data_list: No one... can hold a candle to you.
No one can hope to beat you, huh?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I am well aware.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems this particular compliment was to Gentildonna's liking.
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She seemed somewhat different from before... The Triple Tiara must seem despairingly out of reach to those who lost.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Congratulations.
Excuse me—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Verxina-san.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work.
...You showed tremendous spirit.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "You honed your own running and showed us magnificent tenacity."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It was all—
in order to defeat me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
In other words, my power elevated you...
and your presence lit a fire in me as well.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: You are strong.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I see. That's right...!
Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That is why
I shall move forward.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It's the same as training.
Once you achieve one goal, you apply a heavier load.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that just how you climb
to your next battleground?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: O-On the spot...?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Where do you think it is?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Surely you too... can now see the heights we aim for, yes?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today, Gentildonna demonstrated her power. In that case, what she desires next... is—
choice_data_list: (An "opponent" against whom she can unleash all that power...)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Japan's Orfevre takes 2nd place!!
She gave us hope right until the very finish line!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Though victory at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe eluded her, Orfevre showed the world her strength—and they will surely want a showdown with her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the race Orfevre has
declared her entry for is...
A GⅠ race where the era's strongest Umamusume gather—
choice_data_list: Our next stage will be—the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: That's right!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Japan... Cup...――

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If you still require my chaperoning,
then by all means, do come along as well.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I suspect it will end the same way as today, though... Ho ho ho.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...W-With who I am right now, not yet...
...Now is not the time."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...P-Pardon me...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The look on Verxina's face as she walked away...
The fire was completely gone from her eyes.
Even for her, that must have taken quite a heavy toll.
choice_data_list: I wonder if she can get back on her feet.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If you don't stand back up,
it all ends right there.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "Precisely because she understood it on instinct, she chose to step back for now."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You must realize that blindly charging in like this
will only yield the exact same result.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The more you try to break her, the more brilliantly she blooms.
Make sure you overcome your weaknesses from last time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"If you're still shedding tears the next time we meet...
then I will have misjudged you."
choice_data_list: (So you really do recognize it, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Is this really the time
to stand there smiling and spacing out?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
This is where you show your skill as a Trainer.
—Present the ultimate plan for me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, you yourself...
must have grown since the summer as well.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Show me power worthy of the next stage.
I can count on you, can't I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My heart is pounding... At last,
we'll be competing in earnest
against Senior Class Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the title of the strongest of this era...
I set my sights on the Japan Cup, where the mighty gather.
